_comment: Seed list of company Lever tokens for the lever source. The token is the slug in a board URL: https://jobs.lever.co/<token> (or api.lever.co/v0/postings/<token>?mode=json). Add any company whose careers page is on Lever. Override with LEVER_COMPANIES="tok1,tok2" or a data/lever-companies.json file. Unknown tokens 404 and are skipped.
